L27n832.name: Mid-name subword fragment
L27n832.description: Fires on a middle or later piece of a capitalized name or rare word split into tokens, such as the 'b' in Marbella, 'akes' in Marrakesh, 'On' in Yoko Ono, or 'line' in oxazolidinones. Pushes toward closing quote-and-paren tokens like "), and "].

L27n711.name: Short word-start fragment Le/Re/Te
L27n711.description: Fires on a short capitalized first piece of a word split into tokens, mostly 'Le', 'Re', 'Te', 'Fe' starting names or words (Leukocytes, Leptin, Leibniz, Tees) and 'tre' in 'treacherous'. Pushes toward a '+' followed by a capital letter.

L27n587.name: Name-internal fragment, code closers
L27n587.description: Fires on a piece inside a split word, mostly right after or inside a capitalized name (the 'Z' in KwaZulu, 'A' in Agra, 'I' in ICAO, 'bre' in breeder, 'Bar' in Barua). Pushes toward closing code tokens like ");" and ");".

L27n1053.name: News word-stem, period writer
L27n1053.description: Fires on the first piece of a multi-token word in news-style prose, such as 'susp' (suspending), 'purs' (pursues), 'Cons' (consistent), 'Recon' (reconnaissance), 'roma' (neuroma). Pushes toward sentence endings: a period after a quote, then a newline.

L27n977.name: Mid-name fragment, paren closers
L27n977.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split proper name or word, such as 'ir' in Hirundo, 'B' in Tisha B'Av, 'm' in Mid-nite, 'Sk' in Skopje, 'Su' in Suess, or '-K' in Skutnabb-Kangas. Pushes toward closing ')' and '")' tokens and periods.

L27n1679.name: Split-word piece, db writer
L27n1679.description: Fires on a piece inside a split compound or name, such as '-H' in McGraw-Hill, 'Schw' in Schwann, 'pharmac' in pharmacodynamic, 'crypt' in cryptanalysing, 'iod' in biodiversity, or 'ASS' in NOPASSWD. Pushes toward 'db' and 'DB' tokens.

L27n402.name: Word-onset sl/pl cluster
L27n402.description: Fires on a short mid-sentence word opener that is unfinished, mostly consonant clusters like 'sl', 'pl', 'pr' or 't' (slights, slant, slippers, plasm, tamed). Pushes toward a closing quote and comma, ""," or "").

L27n1165.name: Word-onset j/p/sp fragment
L27n1165.description: Fires on a short word-initial piece that is not yet a full word, mostly 'j', 'p', 'sp', 'spe', 'rem', 'ro' (jarring, patty, spears, juggling, remolded). Pushes toward an opening brace, '{' or '({'.

L27n712.name: Stem-start fragment, '>' writer
L27n712.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, usually a Greek or Latin stem (pal in palatability, Por in Porifera, Ph in Phases, Ne in Neutrophils, cl in clots). Pushes toward '>' followed by a letter, such as '>c' or '>a'.

L27n2014.name: Name fragment, exec writer
L27n2014.description: Fires on a middle piece of a split name or word, such as 'ec' in eczema, 'Mah' in Taj Mahal, 'Bet' in Betts, 'ox' in oxazolidinones, or 'ex' in excommunicated. Pushes toward 'exec' and 'execution' tokens.

L27n1720.name: Word-initial letter f
L27n1720.description: Fires on the letter 'f' or 'F' when it starts a word or word piece, especially after a hyphen ('-f' in '-forked', '-film') or as a capital starting a word (Festival, Fables). Pushes toward 'parse' tokens.

L27n1624.name: Word-start fragment, enum writer
L27n1624.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'pl', 'mel', 'wal', 'er', 'Pl' (placentitis, melon, walnuts), and on capital 'C' and 'E' starting plant or ingredient names. Pushes toward code tokens like '(Enum', 'enum' and 'ctx'.

L27n1660.name: Word-start fragment, config writer
L27n1660.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word, mostly 'fe', 'Le', 'def', 'RIP', 'Ep', 'carp' (febrile, deflection), plus commas in lists such as 'Electons, and Protons'. Pushes toward 'config' and 'configuration' tokens.

L27n2928.name: Word-initial letter c
L27n2928.description: Fires on the letter 'c' or 'C' that starts a word piece, especially after a hyphen ('-c' in anti-cancer, candle, protein-coding, aquacultured) or as a capital (CAGR, Catholicism). Pushes toward 'cache' tokens.

L27n329.name: Capitalized word-onset fragment
L27n329.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, often capitalized (Enh in Enhance, Terr in Terraces, suff in suffocate, pneum in pneumonic, Pl in Placemat, SA in SAARC). Pushes toward a '(' plus a 'c' token like '(pc', '(rc' or 'bc'.

L27n1589.name: Diffuse, inner-fragment, paren closers
L27n1589.description: Weak on most tokens of encyclopedic prose, peaking on one inner fragment of a split word or name ('l' in Borglum, 'ol' in catecholamines, 'K' in K-turn, 'actus' in cactus). Pushes toward closing ')' and '")' tokens.

L27n1421.name: Word after a lead-in
L27n1421.description: Diffuse and weak, peaking on the first content word after a lead-in such as 'such as', 'or', 'according to' or 'for' (flashbacks, nutritional, museum, improving). Pushes toward closing bracket tokens like '】' and '"]'.

L27n937.name: l/m word start, parens
L27n937.description: Fires on a lowercase 'l' or 'm' that starts a word, mostly after a hyphen ('-l' in alpha-linolenic, '-m' in well-maintained, '-l' in limited) or on capital 'L' (Litchi, Lacks). Pushes toward opening '(' tokens like '[(' and '`('.

L27n1713.name: List comma after item
L27n1713.description: Fires most on the comma or semicolon separating items in a list of foods or examples, strongest right after the first item ('tofu, beans', 'salmon, lake trout'). Also weak on fragments like 'contr'. Pushes toward 'temp' tokens.

L27n979.name: Compound-stem fragment, res writer
L27n979.description: Fires on the stem piece of a split compound or name, such as 'micro' and 'ag' in microaggression, 'magn' in magnification, 'chlor' in chlorides, 'Cast' in Castile, or 'fractional' in fractional-reserve. Pushes toward 'res' tokens.

L27n2008.name: Stem before suffix fragment
L27n2008.description: The stem piece of a word split over several tokens, right before its suffix: 'apprec|iating', 'orig|ination', 'necess|itated', 'Spec|ified', 'accom|paniment'. Pushes toward short syllable fragments (PA, HA, GA, BA).

L27n1469.name: Mid-name fragment, writes duration
L27n1469.description: A non-initial piece of a multi-token word or name, e.g. 'Environmental', 'tropo|myosin', 'Di|ane', 'Lem|ur', 'Gyö|rgy'. Pushes toward 'duration', 'longer' and 'longest'.

L27n1736.name: Split-off 'c' letter fragment
L27n1736.description: The letter 'c' or '-c' as a separate piece inside a split word: 'under|c|rust', 'radi|oc|arbon', 'photoc|atalytic', 'count|erc|lockwise', 'c|actus'. Pushes toward 'cur'.

L27n1668.name: Word-internal piece, writes enter
L27n1668.description: A non-initial piece of a multi-token word, e.g. 'hem' in hemlock, 'gor' in Novgorod, 'mon' in monounsaturated, 'en' in Cenozoic. Pushes toward 'enter' and 'exit'.

L27n737.name: Word-fragment, writes female nouns
L27n737.description: A mid-word fragment that opens a longer word: 'cur' in curator, 'inv' in invigorating, 'izz' in frizzled, 'ru' in cruelty, 'mor' in morose. Pushes toward female nouns (women, girl, mother).

L27n1033.name: Piece before el ending
L27n1033.description: The fragment right before an 'el', 'ell' or 'els' ending: 'carp|els', 'kne|els', 'mack|erel', 'kn|ell', 'Fil|ad|elfia', 'bio|fu|els'. Pushes toward 'el'.

L27n1398.name: Word-start fragment, writes increase
L27n1398.description: The short first piece of a word split into tokens: 'sh' (shed, shampoos, shelve), 'Pl' (Plague, Platonist), 'Char' (Charlemagne), 'contr' (contraptions). Pushes toward 'increase' and 'increasing'.

L27n1938.name: Word-start bl/spr, writes driver
L27n1938.description: Word-initial fragments such as 'bl', 'Bl', 'spr', 'cre' (bladder, blower, sprouts, creational), plus 'LED' in display-driver text. Pushes toward 'driver' and 'drive'.

L27n2247.name: Soil/manure nutrient context
L27n2247.description: Soil, manure and nutrient nouns, peaking on 'organic' (organic fertilizer, organic matter, organic waste), 'nitrogen' and 'sewage'. Pushes toward 'return'.

L27n985.name: Infinitive to before verb
L27n985.description: The infinitive 'to' after a verb or adjective, just before a bare verb ('to trip', 'to cool', 'to fall', 'to rest', 'to bubble'). Also word-start 'bl' (blanch, blower). Pushes toward 'store'.

L27n758.name: Size descriptor before noun
L27n758.description: A size or shape modifier before its noun: 'small nonstick', 'large bowl', 'heavy-bottomed sauce', 'cover crops', 'variable frequency drives'. Pushes toward dimension nouns (depth, height, length, width).

L27n1000.name: Short word-start tri/di
L27n1000.description: Short first piece of a multi-token word: 'tri', 'Tri', 'di', 'dis', 'Wi', 'by' (tripped, Tripletails, dioceses, discrediting, Wi-Fi, Abyei). Pushes toward Roman-numeral-like 'i' tokens (ii, iii).

L27n1308.name: Word-start re/rh fragment
L27n1308.description: The first piece of a split word, mostly 're', 'rh', 'Re' (rept-, rhe-umatic, Re-), also 'th', 'Le', 'Comp'. Pushes toward 'recovery', 'recover' and 'restore'.

L27n990.name: Word-start consonant fragment
L27n990.description: The initial piece of a multi-token word, often 'per', 'ch', 'conf', 'fl', 'ph' (perinatal, Chaco, confute, flinch, pharaoh). Pushes toward closing brackets ')', '}' and ']'.

L27n1447.name: Word-start cr/sc cluster
L27n1447.description: A word-initial consonant-cluster fragment: 'cr', 'sc', 'Sc', 'kr', 'Gr' (crabs, scorpion, scraping, krill). Pushes toward markdown '##' heading marks.

L27n2814.name: Lone f, writes fill
L27n2814.description: A lone 'f' or 'F' piece that opens a word fragment: 'un|f|ounded', 'f|using', 'f|rozen', 'F|ocusing', '-f' in God-fearing. Pushes toward 'fill' and 'filled'.

L27n1850.name: Pro/Pr prefix, writes project
L27n1850.description: A word-start 'pro' or 'Pr' fragment: 'pro|portional', 'pro|vision', 'Pr|ize', 'Pr|opulsion'. Also 'rev' and 'av' starts. Pushes toward 'project' and 'projects'.

L27n636.name: Mid-word fragment in names
L27n636.description: A mid-word fragment, mostly inside proper and place names: 'Sats|uki', 'Gua|temalan', 'Nov|gorod', 'Lep|sius', 'Middles|brough', 'Han|uman'. Pushes toward 'uniform' and 'University'.

L27n2698.name: Letter v, writes volume
L27n2698.description: The letter 'v' or 'V' as a split piece: 'low-|voltage', 'current-to-|voltage', 'V|SDs', 'V|ital', 'v|oted'. Pushes toward 'volume' and 'Volume'.

L27n2794.name: Capitalized name fragment
L27n2794.description: The word-start fragment of a capitalized name or place: 'Pseudomonas put|ida', 'Mah|awkin', 'Sar|acen', 'Ne|olithic', 'Mi|ocene', 'Sav|anna'. Pushes toward 'depend' and 'dependency'.

L27n1779.name: Split-word first pieces
L27n1779.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens, where the rest of the word follows, e.g. 'Ste' in Ste|phn, 'fl' in fl|aring, 'dis' in dis|integrates, 'st' in st|ings, and 'am' in 'I am not'. Pushes toward '{' and brace tokens.

L27n662.name: Word-middle fragments
L27n662.description: Fires strongly negative on a subword piece in the middle or end of a split word, e.g. 'init' in Inf|init|ives, 'plac' in plac|ards, 'Ac' in Ac|adian, 'def' in def|ied, 'she' in she|ars, 'ace' in Laur|ace|ae. Going negative pushes toward '(' followed by a capital letter, such as (C, (P, (A.

L27n2705.name: Capitalized name pieces
L27n2705.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a capitalized name mid-sentence when the name is split, e.g. 'Se' in John Se|el, 'Fe' in Chuck Fe|inberg, 'Lin' in Lin|us Pauling, 'T' in T|ete Province, 'Ser' in Ser|engeti. Pushes toward valid and Valid tokens.

L27n1654.name: Pre-ur word fragments
L27n1654.description: Fires positively on the word piece just before an 'ur' sound, e.g. 'conj' in conj|ures, 'ch' in bro|ch|ures, 'nurt' in nurt|ures, 'lux' in lux|urious, 'punct' in punct|uring, 'ple' in ple|ural, 'h' in yog|h|urt. Pushes toward ur, url and URL tokens.

L27n419.name: Mid-word fragments, MB writer
L27n419.description: Fires positively on a short piece in the middle of a word split into several tokens, e.g. 'v' in Nau|v|oo, 'th' in Kapur|th|ala, 'pend' in Har|pend|en, 'inn' in c|inn|abar, 'act' in c|act|i, 'oct' in oct|aBDE. Pushes toward unit-style B tokens such as MB, GB and CB.

L27n2421.name: Short word-initial pieces
L27n2421.description: Fires strongly negative on a short leading piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'g' in g|ilded, 'Can' in Can|averal, 'm' in m|ementos, 'Cav' in Cav|ities, 'lif' in lif|espans, 'rav' in rav|aged, 'Gro' in Gro|ovy. Going negative pushes toward 'email' and 'mail' tokens.

L27n1207.name: Letter-c word fragments
L27n1207.description: Fires strongly negative on a 'c', 'oc', 'yc', 'k' or '-c' piece inside a split word or compound, e.g. 'yc' in Polycystic, 'oc' in meningo|oc|al, '-c' in anti-cancer, 'c' in c|AMP, 'Enc' in Enc|ourage. Pushes toward cal tokens (Cal, (cal, CAL).

L27n2234.name: Name-stem fragments
L27n2234.description: Fires strongly negative on a capitalized or stem fragment that starts a split word, e.g. 'Camb' in Camb|io, 'Serg' in Serg|ipe, 'Urb' in Urb|ium, 'Tit' in Tit|us, 'trib' in trib|uere, 'app' in app|alled, 'acc' in acc|abean. Going negative pushes toward tile, town and village.

L27n1878.name: Word-initial f pieces
L27n1878.description: Fires strongly negative on a standalone 'f' or 'F' that starts a word split from its ending, e.g. 'f' in f|eral, f|idgeting, f|angs, f|ashions, F|ruit, Prof|iciency, and 'ef' in Y|ef|remov. Going negative pushes toward 'evaluat-' and 'eval' tokens.

L27n305.name: Electronics numbers and terms
L27n305.description: Fires strongly negative inside technical voltage and circuit text, on digits inside numbers (the 2 and 0 in 2 0 0 ohm, the 6 in 4 6 V) and on pieces of circuit terms such as Res|istor and -up in pull-up. Going negative pushes toward device and devices.

L27n2465.name: Consonant word-starts
L27n2465.description: Fires strongly negative on a short consonant-initial piece that begins a word split into tokens, e.g. 'B' in B|ortnyik, 'C' in C|zar, 'S' in S|imeon, 'Fr' in Fr|anks, 'Br' in Br|igid, 'c' in c|old, 'fer' in fer|ocious. Going negative pushes toward encode, decode and encoded tokens.

L27n1425.name: Ch word-start digraphs
L27n1425.description: Fires strongly negative on a 'Ch', 'ch', 'Br' or 'P' piece that starts a word split into tokens, e.g. 'Ch' in Ch|aco, Ch|hattisgarh, Ch|ores, Ch|akma, Ch|ao Phraya, and 'P' in P|alla. Going negative pushes toward '>' followed by a letter, such as >i and >d.

L27n1610.name: Technical word-start pieces
L27n1610.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a capitalized or technical word split into pieces, e.g. 'Q' in Q|utb, 'Mand' in Mand|eb, 'Var' in Var|iances, 'Har' in Har|penden, 'St' in St|reak camera, 'N' in N|omenclature, 'underst' in underst|udied. Pushes toward width and wide.

L27n2020.name: Word-start sc/c pieces
L27n2020.description: Fires strongly negative on a 'c', 'C', 'sc' or 'sh' piece that starts a word or follows a hyphen, e.g. 'sh' in sh|ut down and mis|sh|apen, 'c' in c|asserole and c|igarette, 'C' in Anti-C|atholic, 'sc' in sc|atters. Going negative pushes toward owner and own tokens.

L27n1107.name: IPA symbols, name pieces
L27n1107.description: Fires strongly negative on IPA stress and phonetic symbols (the ˈ in /ˈdɔl/, ɪ, ə), on diacritic letters (ḥ, ö), and on syllables inside transliterated foreign names (Tar|quin, cre|monesi, Dol|aucothi, Ah|mad). Going negative pushes toward closing quote-bracket tokens such as ]) and }).

L27n1328.name: URL www, domain pieces
L27n1328.description: Fires strongly negative on 'www' right after http:// or https://, and on domain-name fragments such as hs in dhs.gov, pd and ci in site names, and cert in us-cert.gov. Going negative pushes toward file-extension tokens like .py, .php and .html.

L27n1483.name: Proper-noun initial clusters
L27n1483.description: Fires positively on the opening consonant cluster of a capitalized name or place word, e.g. 'Sh' in Sh|alimar, 'Z' in Z|andi, 'Sl' in Sl|avic and Sl|avery, 'Wh' in Wh|erries, 'Ph' in Ph|ra, 'Cl' in Cl|ifton, 'akh' in Nakh|on. Pushes toward vehicle and vehicles.

L27n1474.name: Pre-predicate function words
L27n1474.description: Fires strongly negative on function words and adverbs mid-clause that sit right before the verb, adjective or noun that completes them: 'and' in contrarious and hurtful, 'has' in has seen, 'have' in have become, 'probably' in would probably be, 'first' in must first come, 'best' in best known, 'old' in old irrigation. Going negative pushes toward closing quote marks.

L27n882.name: Place and term word-starts
L27n882.description: Fires positively on the first sub-token of a place name or long technical word split into pieces, e.g. 'Ban' in Ban|ff, 'Ar' in Ar|bequina, 'Tan' in Tan|-Zam, 'Magn' in Magn|ificent, 'hyp' in hyp|oparathyroidism, 'Ber' in Ber|. Pushes toward closing parenthesis and quote-paren tokens.

L27n697.name: Pre-head noun modifiers
L27n697.description: Fires strongly negative on an adjective or noun that modifies the head noun coming next, e.g. celebrity in celebrity chefs, bathroom in bathroom sinks, North in North Yorkshire, celestial in celestial spheres, Southern in Southern Africa, Social in Agrarian Socialism. Going negative pushes toward closing brace tokens such as } and 》.

L27n2479.name: Split-word 's' fragment
L27n2479.description: Goes strongly negative on a bare 's' or 'S' that opens the second piece of a split word, often after a hyphen or space ('self-|sacrifice', 'Mas-|scaled', ' s|own'). Pushed negative, it writes 'sn' tokens.

L27n1885.name: Formal-text word fragment
L27n1885.description: Strongly positive on the first or second piece of multi-token words in formal text ('Public' in 'Public Switched', 'Cru' in 'Cruelty', 'Str' in 'Strangler', 'ran' in 'supranational'). Pushes 'Sw' tokens.

L27n2288.name: Word-ending 'o/om/os' piece
L27n2288.description: Strongly positive on a short word piece ending in 'o', 'os' or 'om' inside a split word ('os' in 'schistosomiasis', 'lo' in 'gloomy', 'end' in 'Christendom', 'ath' in 'fathoms'). Pushes 'dom'/'domain' tokens.

L27n3008.name: Word-start 't' fragment
L27n3008.description: Strongly positive on a bare 't' (or 'St', 'l') that opens the second piece of a split word ('t|igers', 't|amed', 'T|almud', 'St|ilton', 'l|agoon'). Pushes 'container' tokens.

L27n268.name: Consonant-cluster word opener
L27n268.description: Strongly positive on the opening piece of a split word that starts with a consonant cluster ('wre' in 'wrecks', 'cre' in 'crept', 'bre', 'gre', 'Schro' in 'Schroers'). Pushes consonant-only tokens like 'mt', 'pb', 'ms'.

L27n2633.name: Medical word middle piece
L27n2633.description: Strongly positive on the middle piece of a split medical or science word ('in' in 'Veter|in|arians', 'uk' in 'Le|uk|ocytes', 'ri' in 'sebor|rhea', 'hemat', 'melan'). Pushes 'Python', 'Java' and 'programming' tokens.

L27n2754.name: Split 'S'/'Mos' word start
L27n2754.description: Strongly positive on an 'S' or 'Mos' piece that opens a split word ('-S' in 'Alka|Seltzer', 'Mos' in 'Moslem', 'S' in 'Sita', 'Mes' in 'Mesopotamia'). Pushes 'session' tokens.

L27n1742.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L27n1742.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a split word that opens with a consonant cluster ('pl' in 'pl|agues', 'spl' in 'spl|ints', 'g' in 'g|ilded', 'Sen' in 'Sen|egal'). Pushed negative, it writes 'attribute' tokens.

L27n1808.name: Two-letter word-start piece
L27n1808.description: Strongly positive on short opening pieces of split words, mostly 'ul' in 'ul|cers', 'pl' in 'pl|asm', 'war' in 'war|ms', 'bul' in 'bul|ges', 'aut' in 'aut|onomous'. Pushes capital two-letter tokens 'CS', 'TS', 'DS'.

L27n1754.name: 'c' word-piece
L27n1754.description: Goes strongly negative on a 'c' or 'oc' piece inside a split word ('photoc|atalytic', 'enc|ased', 'oc|ryphal', 'oc|curs', 'radi|oc|arbon'). Pushed negative, it writes 'cr' tokens.

L27n2404.name: Mid-word piece, writes 'feed'
L27n2404.description: Strongly positive on a middle piece of a split word ('heter' in 'heterogeneity', 'squ' in 'squander', 'anch' in 'anchovies', 'crit' in 'critters', 'Break' in 'breakeven'). Pushes 'feed' and 'Fe' tokens.

L27n2351.name: Split-word piece near 'absorb'
L27n2351.description: Strongly positive on the second piece of split words, diffusely ('os' in 'osteosarcoma', 'Fr' in 'Frisian', 'ab' in 'overabundance', 'Re' in 'reusable'), and on 'It' right after 'shock absorber'. Pushes 'abs' and 'absorb' tokens.

L27n2388.name: Word-start 'Bo'/'Ber' piece
L27n2388.description: Strongly positive on the opening piece of a split proper noun or word, mostly 'Bo' ('Bois Blanc', 'Boiry'), 'Ber' ('Berzelius'), 'Or' ('Oriskany') and 'Me' ('Meaux'). Pushes 'association' and 'associate' tokens.

L27n1820.name: Capital name opener
L27n1820.description: Goes strongly negative on the opening piece of a split name or word ('Me' in 'Meaux', 'Pin' in 'Pinatubo', 'Mar' in 'Marquesas', 'Los' in 'Los Angeles', 'Fe' in 'feasibility'). Pushed negative, it writes 'reverse' and 'inverse' tokens.

L27n2596.name: Standalone 'd' word piece
L27n2596.description: Goes strongly negative on a standalone 'd' or 'D' that begins or splits off a word piece ('D|SI', 'd|ialysate', 'd|ihydrogen', 'd|ocking'). Pushed negative, it writes 'dim' and 'dimension' tokens.

L27n369.name: Acronym-opening paren
L27n369.description: Goes strongly negative on the '(' that opens an acronym ('(SAARC)', '(DIC)', '(CCSSO)') and on the capitals inside it ('HT' in 'NHTSA', 'CC'). Pushed negative, it writes capital 'S' tokens like 'SA', 'SB' and 'SF'.

L27n544.name: Acronym-opening paren
L27n544.description: Goes strongly negative on the '(' right before an acronym ('(PPOs)', '(KCCU)', '(CCSSO)'), and on 'ary' in 'prokaryotes'. Pushed negative, it writes doubled capitals like 'SS', 'CC', 'PP' and 'MM'.

L27n2771.name: Latin-Greek science stem
L27n2771.description: Goes strongly negative on a stem piece of a long Latin or Greek scientific word ('OCCUS' in 'Echinococcus', 'trans' in 'transcribing', 'Th' in 'Thelypteridaceae', 'cep' in 'cephalosporins'). Pushed negative, it writes 'transform' tokens.

L27n1797.name: Word-start piece, writes 'det'
L27n1797.description: Strongly positive on the opening piece of a split word ('und' in 'und|etectable', 'Red' in 'Red|uction', 'ad' in 'Fil|ad|elfia', 'cad' in 'cad|mium'). Pushes 'det' and 'detect' tokens.

L27n2776.name: Rare-word second piece
L27n2776.description: Strongly positive on the second piece of rare or foreign words ('Ze|alots', 'chame|leons', 'Ang|olan', 'Kn|idos', 'isotret|inoin'). Pushes 'buffer' tokens.

L27n323.name: Uppercase word-start fragments
L27n323.description: Fires on a bare capital or 1-3 letter uppercase token that opens a word or name split across tokens, mostly in ALL-CAPS headings or after a capitalized name (the 'E' in 'OF E|CHINOCOCCUS', 'F' in 'Masato F|uruhashi'). Pushes toward uppercase word-continuation pieces like IC, DR, CE.

L27n2360.name: First split-word piece
L27n2360.description: Fires on the first 1-3 letter piece of a longer word or name split across tokens, while the rest is still unseen ('n' in vicious-n|uns, 'Tit' in Tit|us, 'recogn' in recogn|ising, 'Pots' in Pots|dam). Pushes toward 'nan' and 'nano' tokens.

L27n1705.name: Short word-start pieces
L27n1705.description: Fires on the short first piece ('cl', 'Int', 'Ind', 'Kh', 'Br', 'Ab') of a word or name split across tokens, e.g. 'grind and cl|enching', 'Wiley-Int|erscience', 'Kh|arkiv', 'Br|aunsbuttel'. Pushes toward 'approx' tokens.

L27n817.name: Capitalized name-part starts
L27n817.description: Fires on the token that opens a capitalized name or compound title ('La' in Ray LaHood, 'Ted' in Ted Stevens, 'El' in El Alamein, 'Dream' in Dreamliner, 'Water' in Water Lilies). Pushes toward single capital letters that start new names.

L27n2594.name: Cut-off opening fragments
L27n2594.description: Fires on a short word opener cut off mid-word: 'ref' in ref|ueling and ref|resher, 'tele' in tele|graph, 'fre' in fre|ighting, 'Tr' in Tr|ims, 'f' in f|errat. Pushes toward 'frame' tokens.

L27n610.name: Name-start fragments before quotes
L27n610.description: Fires on the first fragment of a capitalized surname, place or title split across tokens ('M' in Macc|lesfield, 'P' in Pickett's, 'Ik' in Ikhtiyar, 'Stra' in Straits, 'K' in Kralove). Pushes toward closing quote and apostrophe marks.

L27n1828.name: Noun-initial consonant in lists
L27n1828.description: Fires on a single capital or lowercase consonant opening a noun inside a list or name ('G' in Ghetto, Gobitis, GOCI, Gundisapur; 'M' in Mennonites, Mamba; 'm' in mites, mackerel, mussels; 'H' in Hittite). Pushes toward 'react' tokens.

L27n2280.name: Technical word-start pieces
L27n2280.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split in technical or instructional text: the '-c' of single-celled and foot-candle, the verb 'lie' in 'lie on the table', 'en' in Cenozoic and Cenchrus, 'Cit' in Citigroup, 'Th' in Thinning. Pushes toward 'length' tokens.

L27n2804.name: Piece after split/hyphen
L27n2804.description: Fires on a 2-3 letter piece opening a word after a hyphen or split: '-sp' in fast-spreading and double-spaced, 'sp' in Spill, Spelling and Spinal, 'um' in Mpumalanga. Pushes toward 'mill' and 'thousands', large-quantity words.

L27n1619.name: imm-/m- word starts
L27n1619.description: Fires on the 'imm' or 'Imm' piece opening immemorial, immune, immobility and immunities, and on bare 'm' starts such as mucus and mugs. Pushes toward 'mem' and 'memory' tokens.

L27n2628.name: Lone c in compounds
L27n2628.description: Fires on a lone 'c' or 'C' (or 'photoc') opening the second half of a hyphen or prefix compound: 'Anti-c|ancer', 'Self-c|leaning', 'single-c|elled', 'post-C|ivil', 'photoc|atalytic', '(c|liche)'. Pushes toward 'copy' tokens.

L27n1697.name: Technical name word starts
L27n1697.description: Fires on the first piece of a long technical or proper word split across tokens: 'Nec' in Nec|rolestes, 'pol' in pol|ycrystalline and pol|tergeist, 'Had' in Large Had|ron, '-aut' in semi-aut|onomous, 'rit' in embrit|tlement. Pushes toward 'degree' tokens.

L27n26.name: Instruction and system-prompt openers
L27n26.description: Fires on the word right after an instruction cue or at the start of a chat system prompt: 'You' opening '<|im_start|>system You are a helpful assistant', 'any' in 'double-click any word', 'sign' in 'to sign up'. Pushes toward odd fragments like ':' and 'subrange'.

L27n1581.name: Cl/Col name starts
L27n1581.description: Fires on the first 'Cl', 'Col' or 'cl' piece of a capitalized name or word split across tokens ('Cl|ifton', 'Col|enso', 'cl|apping', 'cl|umps', 'Bl|anche'), and on '%' after an interest rate. Pushes toward 'gender', 'male' and 'female' tokens.

L27n1825.name: Lowercase split-word pieces
L27n1825.description: Fires on a short piece inside a split word with the word unfinished: 'gl' in glaucoma, 'Le' and 'le' in Leeks and lemons, 'ider' in epi|dermis, 'ely' in Th|elypteridaceae, 'med' in med|itate, 'ant' in ant|iretrovirals. Pushes toward 'psych' and 'psychological' tokens.

L27n818.name: Title-case term heads
L27n818.description: Fires on the head word of a Title-Case named term right after its opener: 'K' in 'Vitamin K Deficiency', 'Hunger' in 'Zero Hunger', 'Lights' in 'UFO Lights', 'Dirty' in 'Dirty Dozen', 'Solar' in 'Solar Winds'. Pushes toward 'Log', 'Math' and 'Ge' starts of names.

L27n1034.name: s-start after prefix split
L27n1034.description: Fires on the 's' that opens the second half of a word after a hyphen or split: 'water-s|oluble', 'Water-S|oluble', 'quasi-s|culptural', 'nano-s|cale', 'susp|ensions', 'subs|ided'. Pushes toward 'sol' tokens such as solution and solve.

L27n2088.name: con-/enc- word openers
L27n2088.description: Fires on a 'con', 'enc' or 'spr' opener cut off mid-word: 'Self-con|cepts', 'post-con|sumer', 'pre-con|ceived', 'Enc|ourage', 'enc|roachment', 'spr|outs'. Pushes toward 'construction' and 'construct' tokens.

L27n2281.name: Mid-word pieces of names
L27n2281.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a split name or word, such as 'Bod' in Bod|rum, 'Por' in Por|ifera, 'on' in Alon|zo H. Cushing, 'os' in cyn|os|ure, 'he' in Kas|he|fi, 'om' in chamom|ile. Pushes toward 'phone' and 'mobile' tokens.

L27n2790.name: Split name fragments
L27n2790.description: The first short piece of a capitalized name or rare word that the tokenizer splits, e.g. 'Ne' in von Neumann, 'ep' in Lepsius, 'Fr' in Frisian, 'Ab' in Abi Dawud, 'ent' in entitles; pushes toward 'logic'.

L27n2700.name: Split name/word pieces
L27n2700.description: A first or middle piece of a name or word split into several tokens, e.g. 'Ker' in Keret, 'Hodg' in Hodgskin, 'Hog' in Hogarth, 'Yog' in Yogi, 'spr' in sprouted; pushes toward 'progress'.

L27n2140.name: Single S word starts
L27n2140.description: A one- or two-letter capital start piece, mostly 'S' opening a name (Saver, Sart, Sándor, Siberia) or a hyphen-s piece such as '-s' in quasi-sculptural, and 'os' in stereoscopy; pushes toward 'series'.

L27n550.name: Compound-word stems
L27n550.description: A combining stem whose compound word is still unfinished, e.g. 'Neuro' in neurotransmitters, 'Psycho' in psychotherapy, 'hydro' in hydrotestosterone, 'socio' in socio-spatial, 'poly' in polypropylene; pushes toward word endings 'et', 'ed', 'es'.

L27n2035.name: Verb-stem word fragments
L27n2035.description: The stem piece of a word split before its ending, mostly lowercase verb or noun stems such as 'rec' (recaptured), 'excav' (excavations), 'inc' (incision), 'reinc' (reincarnation), 'asc' (ascended); pushes toward 'feature'.

L27n1395.name: Mid-word syllable pieces
L27n1395.description: A short middle piece of a longer word, e.g. 'erc' in clockwise, 'ic' in bactericidal, 'oc' in radiocarbon, 'rd' in Córdoba, 'fon' in Alfonso, 'sh' in shatter; pushes toward 'count'.

L27n1423.name: Course and unit words
L27n1423.description: The word 'course' (esp. 'this course') and other lesson-structure nouns such as 'lesson', 'activity', 'object' in educational or training text, plus 'Po' and 'mal' word starts; pushes toward 'unit'.

L27n2892.name: Wildlife and hunting context
L27n2892.description: Animal and park words in wildlife or hunting text: 'National' in National Park, 'hunting', 'prey', 'wild', 'ungulates', 'gators', freshwater fish; pushes toward 'game'.

L27n1693.name: All-caps word fragments
L27n1693.description: A letter-group piece inside an all-caps word or name, e.g. 'UL' in DINUZULU, 'IB' in LANGALIBALELE, 'DEV' in DEVIL'S, 'TR' in PROTRAV, 'ULAR' in MULTILOCULAR; pushes toward uppercase fragments like 'AD', 'AB', 'AC'.

L27n1772.name: Name-start word fragments
L27n1772.description: Mostly the first piece of a split word or name, e.g. 'S' in Sita, 'Co' in Coopworth, 'Hy' in Hygiene, 'Ja' in Jaén, 'T' in Tibbon, 'ye' in Yehuda; pushes toward 'maintain' and 'keep'.

L27n2064.name: Second word of compounds
L27n2064.description: The word just before a 'management'-type head in a two-word term, e.g. 'Pest' in pest control, 'Disease' in disease control, 'Edition' in Adobe Digital Edition, 'Mind' in MindMeister, 'content' in content management; pushes toward 'management'.

L27n472.name: bl- word onsets
L27n472.description: The 'bl' that opens a word split across tokens (blanch, blazes, blower, Blu-ray, blurring), plus a few other onsets such as 'bur' in burritos and 'emb' in embrittlement; pushes toward 'Get' and 'get'.

L27n1634.name: 'that' after a noun
L27n1634.description: The word right after a noun phrase that opens a clause, mostly 'that' before a verb (motifs that permeate, an event that triggers), and 'to', 'still', 'really' before a verb; pushes toward 'definition'.

L27n1109.name: Mid-word fragments
L27n1109.description: A middle piece of a longer word split into tokens, e.g. 'ahoo' in Chattahoochee, '-t' in tarred, '-p' in preserved, 'g' in gilded, 'ah' in docosahexaenoic, 'sur' in surges; pushes toward 'file'.

L27n3009.name: 'tr' word onsets
L27n3009.description: The 'tr' that opens a word split into pieces, e.g. 'tr' in trade, trapezoid, trinkets, trams, and 'Tr' in Trivium; pushes toward 'operation'.

L27n1284.name: Surname first pieces
L27n1284.description: The first piece of a surname split into tokens, e.g. 'Hos' in Hosfeld, 'Mol' in Molinaro, 'Her' in Herdwick, 'chen' in Vlaschenko, 'ó' in Káldor; pushes toward 'find' and 'finding'.

L27n585.name: Legal and court words
L27n585.description: Court and law words: 'Court' in Supreme Court, 'attorney' in attorney general, 'charges', 'accused', 'fee', 'FBI', and the word before a legal term such as 'right to'; pushes toward 'legal' and 'authorized'.

L27n803.name: Consonant-onset word starts
L27n803.description: The opening consonant cluster or short onset of a word split into pieces, e.g. 'cl' in clindamycin, 'par' in parathyroid, 'Ch' in Chaco, 'ipp' in Shippuden, 'pr' in prairie, 'sh' in Hiroshima; pushes toward 'value'.

L27n816.name: Capitals starting names
L27n816.description: The capital letter that starts a proper name, brand or acronym, e.g. 'U' in Uclés, 'Ty' in Tylenol, 'Mon' in Monet, 'Puerto Rico', 'Jan' in Rio de Janeiro, 'Microsoft'; pushes toward dotted initials like '.D' and '.A'.

L27n1154.name: Split 'in' and 're'
L27n1154.description: The 'in' inside Mackinac (strongest), the 're' prefix of reconnection, and 'st' starting stirs or stumbles, plus 'social' after a modifier; pushes toward 'connect'.

L27n1827.name: Split technical-term fragments
L27n1827.description: Fires on a mid-word sub-token of a technical or scientific term split into pieces (Ps in Psittacula, co in coagulation, infra in infra-red, ke in keV, ionic conduction), and on 'blood' in medical lists. Pushes toward 'red/Red'.

L27n135.name: Capitalized name onsets
L27n135.description: Goes strongly negative on the first letter or token of a capitalized name or title mid-sentence (L in Lotto, S in Sutak, C in CARS, B in Bower, F in Fahrenheit), and on clause-opening 'so'. Pushes toward word-fragment continuations (aps, uff, ild, udge), giving garbled output.

L27n1164.name: Set-phrase verbs, -M fragments
L27n1164.description: Goes negative on the verb or preposition in set phrases (come into force, take over, take action, reach conclusions, first line of defense) and on capital-M fragments in names (-M in Wisconsin-Madison, Saif-ul-Maluk). Pushes toward '-al' adjectives (mathematical, financial, economic).

L27n2545.name: ALL-CAPS word onsets
L27n2545.description: Fires on the first piece of an ALL-CAPS word or heading (BUSINESS WIRE, LIMITED APPROACH, OTHER SETS, SELLER, DEVIL'S, EXT. ART), and on word-stem pieces like 'underst' in understudied. Pushes toward uppercase HTTP verbs (GET, PUT, POST, DELETE).

L27n2831.name: Standalone P/p word onsets
L27n2831.description: Fires on a lone capital or lowercase 'P' or 'p' that starts a word or name (Pesticides, Pisa, Puzzles, Pickett's, -pirate), and on 'ep' pieces (epidermis, epigenetics). Pushes toward listening and hearing verbs (listen, hearing, reading).

L27n1004.name: Word-internal fragments
L27n1004.description: Fires on a fragment inside a longer word or name (hip in hippos, cal in calici-, vis in cerevisiae, ely in Thelypteridaceae, isc in Priscus), and on a few plain words after a preposition ('direct fan', 'head start', 'higher efficiency'). Pushes toward 'start/starting'.

L27n335.name: Capitalized noun-head onsets
L27n335.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or noun head (Bo in Boer, B in B-29, O in OER, Vil in Vilas, V in V2 rockets), and on nouns like water, ozone and taste (waterways, ozone layer, taste buds). Pushes toward generic data-structure nouns (matrix, network, tree, table, array).

L27n442.name: Split-word opening syllables
L27n442.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of a split word or name (ost in mangosteen, Koh in Kohli, fl in sulfoxaflor and fluff, ref in refueling, Inf in Infinitives, wan in Kwanzaa, F in Fruit). Pushes toward short syllable fragments (uru, ulu, LU, BU), which produce nonsense.

L27n533.name: Split words, generic nouns
L27n533.description: Fires on the first piece of a split word (mul in mulch, col in colander, cant in cantaloupe, aut in autocrat, atal in catalytic), and on a word right before a generic noun (open-source, search box, good look). Pushes toward generic nouns: service, program, algorithm, method, project.

L27n838.name: Capitalized H/B/T onsets
L27n838.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized name or word, mostly H, Har, B, T, Th, Ar or Sh (Harbinder, Haven't, Babylon, Talmud, Tibbon, Arnett). Pushes toward exclamation marks.

L27n983.name: 'self' in compounds
L27n983.description: Goes negative on 'self' in hyphenated or capitalized compounds (self-compassion, self-harming, self-reported, self-checking), plus some word-onset pieces (aqu in aquaculture, Jo in Joaquin). Pushes toward 'self' itself, which then repeats.

L27n2053.name: Split capitalized word onsets
L27n2053.description: Fires on the first piece of a split capitalized name or word (Th in Thespians, Tit in Titus, Phar in Pharisees, Kh in Kharkiv, lact in lactose, sw in swamps, hal in halving). Pushes toward 'target/targets'.

L27n1504.name: Opening piece of names
L27n1504.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of a capitalized or split name (P in Polar bear and Pumsaint, Ap in Apocrypha, Nap in Napster, Ant in Antonio, hypoth in hypothalamus), and on the comma after a list of nouns. Pushes toward 'lines/rows/eyes'.

L27n2678.name: Lone 'f' word onsets
L27n2678.description: Goes negative on a lone 'f' that starts a word or hyphenated part (-fatty in trans-fatty, -forked, -fins, floss, fleas, fumes, family, fabrication, stir-fry). Pushes toward 'old/Old'.

L27n584.name: Compound-noun modifiers
L27n584.description: Goes negative on the word that modifies the next noun in a compound (tree house, heel pain, oil production, neural stem cells, sexual intercourse, tin-zinc), and on being, will or after before a verb or noun. Pushes toward consonant-cluster word starts (pl, fl, tr, cl, sp).

L27n2213.name: Name word onsets
L27n2213.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or compound (Ub in Graubünden, Z in Zatorre, Eug in Eugen, Sh in Shiloh, Mu in Muir Beach, Ch in Chaco, sm in smog, ch in chowders). Pushes toward 'meet/meeting'.

L27n1463.name: Punctuation before parentheses
L27n1463.description: Fires on punctuation that opens a parenthesis or joins a compound: '-' in protect-your and ill-posedness, '(' in (AIDS) and (Musical, '=' in F=∂A and x=0, '/' in Consumer/Event. Weak effect; pushes toward capital abbreviation starts (SU, LB, SF, DH).

L27n635.name: Capital P, IPA symbols
L27n635.description: Fires on a capital 'P' starting a word (Patches, Potters, Packed, Pies, Pustules), on the digit after the copyright sign in years (2 in 2005), and on IPA stress and vowel symbols (ˈ, ɪ, ə). Pushes toward asterisk and symbol tokens (*, %, @, &).

L27n1565.name: 'cr' animal-noun onsets
L27n1565.description: Goes negative on the 'cr' onset token starting animal and farm nouns (crocodiles, crabs, crickets, cranes), plus 'ple' in pleural and 'agr' in agritech. Pushes toward 'man/Man' tokens.

L27n1122.name: Water nouns, was/been
L27n1122.description: Goes negative on water and kitchen-type nouns (Sea in Sea Berry, water in waterways and groundwater, kitchen table, lawn, limestone), and on 'was' or 'been' before a passive verb (was originally presented, have been abandoned). Pushes toward 'table/tables'.

L27n1749.name: Word-start fragments, places
L27n1749.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into several tokens ('distra|ught', 'carp|accio', 'Bour|ges', 'shr|ub') and on place names and proper nouns in lists ('Budapest', 'Forest', 'Put'); pushes weakly toward 'writing' and 'hot', with no clear output.

L27n1032.name: Opening fragments, 'affected'
L27n1032.description: Fires on the first piece of a long word split into subword tokens while the word is still unfinished ('thr|ong', 'exc|elled', 'uncon|scious', 'sh|rouded'); pushes toward 'affected', 'impacted' and 'damaged', so steering spams 'affected'.

L27n364.name: Digits inside numbers
L27n364.description: Fires on a digit or fraction in the middle of a number split across tokens (the '6' in 1863, the '7' in 787, the fraction '⅔'); pushes toward 'three', 'third' and '3', so steering spams 'Three'.

L27n1063.name: Initial letters of names
L27n1063.description: Fires on a one- or two-letter opening fragment of a split proper noun, usually a capital ('G|arter', 'G|alloway', 'E|ton', 'Har|riette', 'Rah|ane'); pushes toward 'const' code tokens, so steering spams 'const'.

L27n1950.name: Short split-word fragments
L27n1950.description: Fires on a short 2-3 letter opening piece of a word split into subword tokens, often a rare or capitalised name ('Te|esside', 'Eup|hr|ates', 'Cl|ifton', 'gl|abrous', 'sw|immers'); pushes toward 'your', 'you' and 'vous', so steering spams 'your'.

L27n1550.name: Nationality adjectives, 'import'
L27n1550.description: Fires on a nationality or country adjective placed before its noun ('Cuban', 'Soviet', 'Danish', 'German', 'Swedish', 'Australian'), and weakly on 'surre' in 'surrealist'; pushes toward 'import', so steering spams 'import'.

L27n492.name: Diffuse noun-phrase endings
L27n492.description: Diffuse: fires on the last word of a noun phrase or list item ('eggs', 'radishes', 'bread', 'inches', 'SC') and on the final digit of a measurement ('500 grams', '500 °C'); pushes toward a backslash token with no clear meaning.

L27n1360.name: ALL-CAPS letter fragments
L27n1360.description: Fires on capital-letter pieces inside ALL-CAPS words and acronyms, mostly the second or later piece ('MESSENG|ER', 'CET|SHWAYO', 'IN|TELLIGENCE', 'CY|CLE', 'PO|C'); pushes toward more capital-letter pieces, especially 'E', so steering spams 'Eve'.

L27n1359.name: Auxiliaries before verbs
L27n1359.description: Fires on an auxiliary or infinitive marker just before its verb ('be' in 'will be abandoned', 'to' in 'to repair', 'is' in 'is cut', 'can' in 'can be', 'or' in 'or donated'); pushes toward 'real' and 'Real', so steering spams 'real'.

L27n650.name: Leading word fragments
L27n650.description: Fires on the opening 1-3 letter piece of a capitalised or rare word split into subword tokens ('S|curvy', 'Ne|utron', 're|seeded', 'blo|oming', 'del|ves'); pushes toward 'were', 'are' and 'weren', so steering spams 'Are'.

L27n654.name: Mid-word fragments, 't' output
L27n654.description: Fires on a mid-word piece of a word split across tokens, often the second piece ('pan/til|t', 'rebut|tal', 'forfe|it', 'interpre|ts', 'exoplan|et'); pushes toward a bare 't' as the next piece, so steering spams 't'.

L27n2855.name: Name-like word fragments
L27n2855.description: Fires on a 2-3 letter piece inside a longer name or word split across tokens, usually the second or third piece ('Kh|isa', 'Tong|a', 'chir|ping', 'mel|odic', 'Bel|oved', 'feng-sh|ui'); pushes toward 'energy', so steering spams 'Energy'.

L27n2634.name: Capital two-letter word starts
L27n2634.description: Fires on a capitalised two-letter opening piece of a word split across tokens ('Ch|ronic', 'Ch|ia', 'Ch|ores', 'De|portation', 'Th|amma'); pushes toward the pipe character '|', so steering spams pipes.

L27n582.name: Diffuse sentence-setup tokens
L27n582.description: Diffuse: fires on tokens that set up a following predicate or list item, such as commas and 'and' in lists, 'is' after a subject, 'before', 'only', 'heat', and 'I' before 'am'; pushes toward 'aware', 'conscious' and 'wishes', so steering spams 'wishes'.

L27n1191.name: Middle word fragments
L27n1191.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a long word split into subword tokens, usually 2-4 letters ('Nov|gor|od', 'law-ab|iding', 'ther|mostatic', 'abs|cess', 'proph|esied'); pushes toward 'es' and 'és' suffix pieces that continue the word, so steering spams 'es'.

L27n1349.name: Short fragments, rare words
L27n1349.description: Fires on a short fragment, often 2 letters, that opens a rare, capitalised or technical word split across tokens ('tr|is', 'Bl|anche', 'Nec|rolestes', 'V|itiligo', 'TR|UL|Y'); pushes toward 'answer' and 'Answer', so steering spams 'answer'.

L27n1587.name: Word fragments, 'original' output
L27n1587.description: Fires on mid-word pieces of long or technical names ('Kor|moran' as 'orm', 'melan|in', 'Sab|rina', 'ket|osis', 'ac|rophobia') and on some whole names ('Claude', 'Best'); pushes toward 'original' and 'originally', so steering spams 'original'.

L27n515.name: Conjunctions after noun phrases
L27n515.description: Fires on a conjunction or relative word ('and', 'or', 'that', 'which', 'these') right after a noun or clause, where a new clause or alternative starts ('allergies and forms', 'diseases or injuries', 'cells which'); pushes toward 'result', 'cause' and 'form'.

L27n698.name: Technical-term fragments, 'data'
L27n698.description: Fires on a piece inside a technical term or proper name split across tokens ('bi|ostatistics', 'Int|erscience', 'gu|ayule', 'Gutz|on', 'Leth J|ø|rgensen'), and on whole words like 'Resources' and 'Protection'; pushes toward 'data' and 'Data', so steering spams 'data'.

L27n861.name: Pre-noun modifiers
L27n861.description: Fires on a number word, quantifier or adjective right before its head noun ('two' in 'two teeth', 'few' in 'a few ice', 'other', 'numerous', 'sticky foods', 'hot sauce'); pushes toward institution nouns like 'company', 'university' and 'school', so steering spams 'company'.

L27n1826.name: Mid-word subword fragment
L27n1826.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a rare word split into several tokens, such as 'st' in min|st|rel, 'wil' in wil|de|beest, 'b' in Middles|b|rough, and 'isc' in omn|isc|ient. The word is unfinished at that point. It pushes the output toward 'rel'-style word-piece continuations, and steering only spams 'rel'.
